name: state-message
description: A state the page is in, written where the content would be: loading, a failure, nothing found. A line of copy or help, and sometimes a row of actions (try again). In a sheet it takes the sheet's padding.

tag.description: p for a single line. line: the text module's help line with this section's class mixed in (one element, role status).

children.description: The copy or help line (the shared .auth-copy / .auth-help) and the action row.

places.span: a nested state message: the full grid
places.copy: the explanatory copy: --s6 above what follows
places.help: a help line (a nested status line): --s4 above what follows
places.actions: its action row (a cluster): --s4 by --s7 apart, --s7 below

states.hover: n/a: a section is not a control; its controls carry their own
states.focus-visible: n/a: not focusable; its controls carry the ring
states.loading: n/a: it is how loading is shown, not a state of it
states.error: n/a: it is how a failure is shown

a11y.role: status where it announces (the copy carries role=status or alert)

changelog.change: Tag line: the text module's help line carrying this section's class (a mix), announced (18-entry-system-states: an edit that didn't save, a recording that didn't send). Pages round 4b.
